solutions.title: Iterative skip duplicates
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Walk; while `next` equals current value, skip `next`; else advance.

**Why preferred:** Minimal state; classic sorted-list trick.

**Example walkthrough:** At the first `1`, next is also `1`, so skip the next node. Move on when values differ → `[1, 2]`.

solutions.title: Skip equal next nodes
solutions.description:
**Approach:** If `current.val === current.next.val`, set `current.next = current.next.next`; else move forward.

**vs recommended:** Aligns with the recommended solution — keep practicing narration of pointer updates.

**Example walkthrough:** Same unlink: while `current.val === current.next.val`, set `current.next = current.next.next`.
